content:
If you like the new wallpaper Apple created for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't need to buy a new iPhone to use it—you can download it right here.

Download the new iPhone 18 Pro wallpaper

Although the default iOS wallpaper is dynamic and reacts to the device's motion and gestures, what we have below are static images captured directly from the first iOS 27 Release Candidate.

The Release Candidate doesn't seem to include the iPhone Duo wallpaper, so you may have to wait a few more weeks—possibly until iOS 27.1.

Remember to tap or click the image to download the full-resolution wallpaper, then set it as your background via the Photos app or the Settings app (if you're on an iOS device).
